summary: ALTER TABLE operation caused blocking due to lock contention.
symptoms: Database froze during ALTER TABLE operation
Login queries blocked due to table lock
Required killing the ALTER TABLE process to resume operations
mechanism: ALTER TABLE operation acquires ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock, blocking all other operations on the table. Long-lived weak locks (e.g., idle transactions) exacerbate the issue by preventing the lock acquisition.

value.sql: ALTER TABLE cliente ADD COLUMN topicos character varying(20)[];

facts.evidence: Post includes the exact SQL statement causing the issue.

value.blocking_behavior: Prevents all other access to the table

facts.evidence: Post and answers describe lock contention during ALTER TABLE.
Answer suggests idle transactions holding weak locks as a likely cause.

assumptions: The synthetic database will replicate lock contention behavior under similar conditions.
Idle transactions or weak locks will be simulated to reproduce blocking.
unknowns: Exact workload or query patterns during the incident
Whether other operations (e.g., index creation) were performed after ALTER TABLE
